name: B10-0424/2026 – After recital B – Am 123
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Be. whereas, according to the Council of Europe, politicians have both a political obligation and a moral responsibility to refrain from using hate speech and stigmatising language, and to condemn promptly and unequivocally its use by others, as silence may be interpreted as approval or support and as the enhanced protection of freedom of expression that they enjoy also increases their responsibility in this area;
